newsitem.title: USA: Uganda seen first to win multilateral debt relief.
newsitem.headline: Uganda seen first to win multilateral debt relief.

text.p: Uganda is likely to be the first of a number of poor nations to be considered for multilateral debt relief in the coming months, World Bank President James Wolfensohn said on Wednesday.
"It still looks like Uganda is likely to be the first subject of discussion," Wolfensohn told a news conference.
He said the Bank's board will take up its first case under the debt relief program before the organization's next semi-annual meeting at the end of April.
Up to five countries could be considered under the program by October.
